title: Transfer of a ComfortLease Lease When the Home Is Sold
content:
**Guidance for sellers, buyers and their agents — ComfortLease Equipment Leases**

Where transfer on sale is allowed, a lease passes to the buyer of the home when the buyer meets the eligibility for signing a ComfortLease lease and the transfer is completed no later than 30 calendar days after the sale closes; a transfer fee of $75.00 is charged to the buyer. A lease is transferred only while its status is active. A lease not transferred in time stays with the seller, who may buy it out or terminate it.

| Leased system | Transfer on sale allowed | Transfer fee, charged to the buyer | Window after the sale closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | Yes | $75.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Central Air | Yes | $75.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | Yes | $75.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | Yes | $75.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | Yes | $75.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | Yes | $75.00 | 30 calendar days |

## What a transfer requires

- **The lease:** its status is active, as the lease record shows. A lease that is pending installation, past due, bought out or terminated is not transferred.
- **The buyer:** meets the eligibility for signing a ComfortLease lease.
- **The timing:** the transfer is completed on or before the 30th calendar day after the sale closes.

When all three hold, the lease passes to the buyer, who becomes the lessee, and the $75.00 transfer fee is charged to the buyer.

## Cases (hypothetical sales)

| Lease status | Buyer meets signing eligibility | Transfer completed | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | 12 days after closing | Lease passes to the buyer; $75.00 charged to the buyer |
| Active | Yes | On the 30th day after closing | Lease passes to the buyer — the 30th day is within the window |
| Active | Yes | Not by the 30th day after closing | Lease stays with the seller, who may buy it out or terminate it |
| Past due | Yes | 5 days after closing | Not transferred — the lease is not active |
